name: Prayer to Elune
summary: At Zamael Lunthistle's request, you seek a prayer to Elune lost among the idol worshippers. Engraved on a golden tablet, it is meant for Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.

sections.title: The Lost Prayer
sections.body: Zamael Lunthistle's faith has awakened again. Yet he says that means little after the harm he has done to the world and its people. He expects no absolution. He asks only for his prayer to be heard, so you seek the golden tablet from the idol worshippers and carry it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.

sections.title: At the Temple of the Moon
sections.body: At the Temple of the Moon, Astarii Starseeker tells you that Elune smiles upon you this evening. By your hand, a lost soul has returned to her. Astarii gives you thanks.

faq.answer: Zamael Lunthistle asks you to find his prayer to Elune. His faith has returned, though he has done countless acts of harm against the world.

faq.q: What is the prayer inscribed on?
faq.answer: Zamael's prayer is engraved on a golden tablet. He believes one of the idol worshippers carries it.

faq.q: To whom should the prayer be delivered?
aliases: where do i bring the prayer
faq.answer: Carry the prayer to Astarii Starseeker at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Does Zamael expect forgiveness for his past?
faq.answer: No. Zamael expects no absolution for his past, but asks that his prayer be heard.
